question: What angle and sliding-direction contrast follows from a shared passive bath driven by the published three-wave PES?
assumptions: published rigid first-star PES Eq2, Table4
three independent equal passive Debye coordinates driven by its three cosines
same bath and per-atom contact transfer across N7,N13 only for conditional ratio
physical_mapping: per upper atom low-speed drag tensor in physical units; AFM contact, UD source and measured loss OPEN

known_targets: detectable paired peaks and negligible load dependence
fitted_choices: equal independent bath channels are a chosen conventional null, not fitted force data
minimal equal three-mode bath chosen for symmetry, no kinetic fit
sources: Chen et al. PRL 137 166201 public abstract
baseline: two-dimensional DFT first-star PES plus independent equal Debye loss
result: Exact low-speed isotropic drag tensor 3lambda² eta U1²g²/(4kappa²) I. First sixfold directional power term at v^6. Source-rounded shared-bath N7/N13 drag ratio 651175/6877≈94.688818; not measured or UD-specific.
next_discriminant: measured complex loss and contact transfer, frozen conventional 2D force/pressure/velocity prediction, held-out signed UD residual
